transcript.answer: Otto's `off` TMS mode was removed on 2026-10-16, in commit e773dd86 ("Run the stand-in TMS everywhere until OLT's key arrives, and drop the off mode"). The commit was part of the review of #403 and followed #399. `off` had been introduced a day earlier, on 2026-10-15, in commit 8bca0804, when `TMS_MODE` was `off`, `stand-in` or `live`. After the removal, `TMS_MODE` accepts only `stand-in` or `live`. The `off` mode was dropped from the config, the Helm chart, CI and the docs.
